refactor(renderer): the renderer's acts and reads cross as notices and awaited calls (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.5ym)

Every reach the renderer makes into the host is now a notice (answers
void) or an awaited call (answers a promise of plain data), and a
compile-time check, Reaches, holds the whole host-call surface to that.

- The launch, the slash typing, the doctor's reads and install facts,
  the serving daemon, the client sightings and the idle confirm are
  awaited; the click's launch bound lives with the host.
- The idle clock's reading rides the request and the frame push, so the
  draw reads no host clock in place.
- A refresh answers each lane's time instead of filling a map it was
  handed.
- A record's undefined value no longer crosses, so a launch's env
  overlay unsets with null, which JSON keeps.
- The doctor's gather moves to a shared module the renderer side imports.

refactor(renderer): the host's pushes cross a process, each an adapter input answered by its reply alone (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8rc) (#747)

* refactor(renderer): the host's pushes cross a process, each an adapter input answered by its reply alone (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8rc)

Every reach of the host into the renderer is now an AdapterPush, plain
data checked at build time to cross a process (Crosses<T>), answered by
an AdapterOutput: the reply of the push's own kind, or how it threw.
rendererHost.ask is the one judge of a reply's kind; tell logs a
failure nothing awaits.

- The feed asks for its frame and its lanes, so a frame lands later: a
  wake while it is out is owed the next frame at the spacing, however
  the frame ended, and a subscribe is admitted once its lanes answer,
  opening nothing for one refused or gone meanwhile.
- The pin owns the session's state wake, so the wake lives as long as
  the feed.
- Journal turns are the renderer's. The daemon's close awaits the
  renderer's three teardown steps in today's order, and shutdown awaits
  the close before it exits.
- A render's wait ends when the render cache closes, said as
  ended=closed, so a render the close interrupts holds no timer past it.
- A heap-retainer test draws in a frame of its own, so the suspended
  test frame's registers cannot hold the drawn store.

* fix(renderer): a frame's Infinity crosses as its wire form, and a failed frame still gates its lanes (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8rc)

High review of #747. A feed frame's and a present's bar cross as WireFrame and
the host parses them where they land, since JSON carries Infinity as null and
no type tells it from a finite number. A failed feed frame reads its lanes from
the view, so a lane switched off while the render throws still ends. One
rendererOf dispatches each input to its typed arm, the reading reply kinds are
derived from their arms, a push that rejects is said with its renderer and
kind, and a subscribe that lands after the close is logged.

* fix(renderer): an admission that throws is refused, the shutdown exit always runs, and Crosses names any (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8rc)

Medium review of #747. A subscribe's admission runs after its lanes arrive, so
a throw in it is logged and answered RENDER_FAILED rather than an unhandled
rejection. The shutdown's cleanup after the close logs a throw and still exits
with its code. Crosses refuses an any, which passed every test unread. The two
click-error writers share one push, and two comments and a test name follow
the async close and the owed wake.

* fix(renderer): a subscribe whose lanes cannot be read is refused, and a draw is held to waking nothing (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8rc)

Second high review of #747. A lanes read or an admission that throws refuses
the subscriber RENDER_FAILED and drops it wherever it got to: admitting it as
a session with no view left it open forever when the same fault broke every
frame. The owed wake is read as the phase is replaced, so a wake the push
raised is kept. A bounded wait tells its late failure how it ended. A test
holds that a feed's draw moves neither the view's data nor the session's
state, and the frame-feed fake carries lanes on failed frames as the renderer
does. rendererOf lives beside the interface it builds.

* fix(daemon): every shutdown step runs whatever one before it threw, and a subscriber that left hears no refusal (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.8rc)

Low review of #747. The close, the lease removal and the registry release are
steps each said by name on a throw, so a close that failed still gives up the
lease. A subscriber that left before its admission failed is not refused.
